names_note: printed tip names as printed ('Concornis lacutris', 'Apsaravis ukhaana', 'Anas platyrhychus', 'Crypturellus undullatus'), including the specimen tips 'IGM 100/1323', 'IGM 100/1126' and 'IGM 100/44' and the genus-only tips Epidexipteryx, Lithornis, Crax and Unenlagia
gold_note: Paravian jackknife consensus, read by eye; the run-length line reader agreed on the dromaeosaurid half but shifted the troodontid tips by one, so it was used only as a check. Multi-way nodes: the ornithurine node (Iaceornis, Ichthyornis, the hesperornithiform pair and the crown), the crown node (Crypturellus, Lithornis, Neognathae), the five microraptorines, four dromaeosaurines and four velociraptorines. No clade names are printed; the numbers are GC values. 65 tips, 5 polytomies (4, 3, 5, 4, 4 children). Random-sample case (seed 20261122). Topology transcribed from the figure image and checked node by node; topology only.
